July was, in many ways, a mixed bag. While it was flooded with news of large corporations gobbling up Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Solana – a trend that’s still ongoing – the cryptos themselves didn’t react as positively as many had hoped.
 
That said, September has brought a wave of newfound enthusiasm, fueled by the potential for a Federal Reserve rate cut.
 
 
According to Polymarket, there’s now over a 95% chance the Fed will slash rates, sparking risk-on sentiment among investors, which could, in turn, send crypto to the moon, just like it did the last time.
 
Exciting, right? But here’s the big question: how do you pick the right cryptos to prepare for this bull run?
 
 
Do you simply stack BTC, ETH, and SOL? While safer, many argue this approach is too risk-averse, especially with expecta…

Bitcoin ($BTC) is the king of the hill in the cryptocurrency market. In fact, even people who don’t know anything about crypto will have likely heard of Bitcoin.

articles.author: Ronaldo Marquez
articles.description:
Strategy, formerly known as MicroStrategy, has made major inroads into the crypto market with its bold transformation into a Bitcoin (BTC)  treasury, a move that has yielded substantial unrealized gains over the past year. 
 
Michael Saylor’s approach has positioned the enterprise software firm as a potential candidate for inclusion in the S&P 500, an index of the 500 largest publicly traded companies in the United States.
